name: dsh-matrix
description: Intent-level declaration of the dsh runtime install matrix (see dsh-matrix/README.md and ADR-0007/0023). The full package closure is resolved once and frozen in package-lock.json — never hand-edit the lock. Since 0.2.0 the whole dsh family ships as exact-pinned hard dependencies of one lockstep version, so intent rows are composition facts only (what the platform's profile scaffold directly composes: the dsh CLI, the dsh-base bundle, the inserted sdk-jsonrpc-server plugin) — no overrides, no generation unification needed.
